verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents On-Call Readiness Reports (notification config health) and an 'Insights Agent' that gives 'proactive recommendations and on-demand conversational insights based on your Incidents, Services, and Teams analytics,' plus AI Orchestrations that 'analyze historical events and incidents and surface recommended rules that reduce noise, improve MTTR' — these point toward reliability/on-call health analytics, but no doc explicitly describes MTTA/MTTR trend dashboards or incident-load trend reporting for leaders. Missing for 10: explicit MTTA/MTTR trend visualization, incident load over time reporting, and independent/hands-on validation that these analytics reliably show improvement.
